candidates.quote: By Resolution No. 2011-18, the City approved a 15-year partial property tax exemption for the Project.
candidates.wording: approved a 15-year partial property tax exemption

candidates.quote: The exemption is granted in exchange for the affordability terms in this Agreement.
candidates.wording: granted in exchange for the affordability terms

candidates.quote: The Owner shall reserve 9 of the 60 homes in the Project as Affordable Homes.
Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 50 percent of Area Median Income.
candidates.wording: income at or below 50 percent of Area Median Income

candidates.quote: Monthly rent for each Affordable Home shall not exceed 30 percent of 50 percent of Area Median Income, adjusted for household size.
candidates.wording: shall not exceed 30 percent of 50 percent of Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The Affordability Period begins on January 1, 2012 and ends on December 31, 2026.
candidates.wording: begins on January 1, 2012 and ends on December 31, 2026

candidates.quote: The Owner is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner of the Project.
candidates.wording: binds every later owner of the Project

candidates.quote: The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by March 31 of each year.
candidates.wording: shall deliver an annual compliance certificate

candidates.quote: If a default is not cured within 30 days after written notice from the City, the Owner shall repay the property taxes exempted during the period of default.
candidates.wording: repay the property taxes exempted during the period of default

candidates.quote: The City may also seek specific performance of this Agreement.
